source_snapshot.procedure: After debug/WHEA BIOS changes, halt Windows through ITP and call `ei.injectI3CControllerError(socket=0,lpss=0,errType=0x13)`.
source_snapshot.criteria: Intentional hang plus catastrophic/fatal BMC, UEFI, front-panel and applicable LCD response.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; post-fault host collection is incompatible with the expected hang.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires controller ownership, target expansion, fatal oracle and OOB recovery.

old_problem: The source claims Socket 0~N but hardcodes socket0/LPSS0, does not define 0x13, conflicts with the project BMC-owned I3C default, and expects evidence from a host that should hang.
disposition_reason: ED-03 cannot parameterize an unidentified controller path or error opcode: those determine what hardware is faulted. ED-16 also requires a proven stop/recovery path before fatal injection. Until a platform authority proves the Intel-LPSS exception, defines 0x13, enumerates real socket/controller commands and supplies an independent recovery oracle, the command meaning and safety are indeterminate; therefore this is a genuine engineering block, not merely a missing IP or package path.
decision_basis: Directly read Reliability row 28 and same-row AI fields, historical record 2432, and next pending row 29.
Preserved all-socket coverage; the socket0 example is not extrapolated.
Applied project I3C ownership rule: BMC/platform management remains default absent an approved exception.
Rejected SSH/dmesg as primary post-hang evidence and retained physical indicator/LCD coverage.
No injection, BIOS change, reset or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: I3C controller fatal-hang injection across supported sockets
test_case.purpose: Inject the approved I3C controller fatal condition on every supported socket/controller and verify the bounded hang, management-plane fatal records, indicators and recovery.
required_package: Platform authority identifying I3C owner and any Intel-LPSS exception
Supported ITP/CScripts hash and authoritative 0x13 definition
Maximum hang and exact BMC/UEFI/panel/LCD oracle
Independent OOB reset/recovery and BIOS restoration procedure
test_case.test_command: Do not execute the current command. After approval, an FAE may run one explicitly mapped target under synchronized ITP, serial-console and BMC capture, enforce the approved hang timeout, preserve management evidence, perform the authorized recovery, gather recovered UEFI records and restore settings.
test_case.expected_result: For each approved target, the defined fatal I3C event causes the bounded hang, exact BMC/UEFI records and applicable panel/LCD state, followed by successful controlled recovery and restored health.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS is available until controller ownership, opcode semantics, target matrix, exact fatal signatures and recovery are authoritative. A hang alone, generic `i3c` text, the hardcoded socket0 example, or post-reboot host logs cannot establish PASS.
safety_gate: Dedicated idle SUT, independent console/OOB access and qualified FAE.
No run without ownership/opcode/target proof and a tested recovery timer.
One target only; abort on wrong controller/severity or loss of OOB control.
Never autonomously reset, power-cycle or retry.
expected_evidence: Package hash/opcode definition and per-target commands
Exact fatal records and visual indicator evidence
Recovery, restored settings/health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Currently unresolved. The platform owner must issue the exact reset/recovery path that preserves evidence and returns BIOS/controller state to baseline; this missing safety-critical element keeps execution blocked.
